docs.title: Column  firebase performance
docs.text:
firebase_performance_event_timestamp: Timestamp of the Firebase Performance trace. Partition column (daily); filter on a date range.

firebase_performance_event_type: Type of the Firebase Performance event. Always 'TRACE_METRIC': the model keeps only trace metrics.

firebase_performance_event_name: Name of the Firebase Performance trace metric. Always 'home_time_to_interactive_in_ms': the model keeps only this metric.

firebase_performance_operating_system: Operating system of the device, set from the source export. Stored values: 'IOS', 'ANDROID'.

firebase_performance_app_display_version: Version of the app that sent the trace.

firebase_performance_home_time_to_interactive_container_in_ms: Home time to interactive in milliseconds: delay before the Home screen is usable, from the Firebase Performance trace 'home_time_to_interactive_in_ms' (TRACE_METRIC), iOS and Android.

docs.title: Column  institutional event
docs.text:
institutional_event_user_first_touch_timestamp: Timestamp of the first visit of the browser (user_pseudo_id) on the institutional website.

institutional_event_device_hostname: Hostname of the institutional website on which the event was recorded (pass.culture.fr, or the testing website).

institutional_event_geo_region: Region of the user, as geolocated by Google Analytics from the IP address.

institutional_event_geo_city: City of the user, as geolocated by Google Analytics from the IP address.

institutional_event_user_traffic_campaign: Name of the marketing campaign that first acquired the user (first-touch attribution).

institutional_event_user_traffic_medium: Medium of the marketing campaign that first acquired the user (first-touch attribution).

institutional_event_user_traffic_source: Source of the marketing campaign that first acquired the user (first-touch attribution).

institutional_event_ga_session_id: Google Analytics session identifier (session start unix timestamp). Unique only when combined with user_pseudo_id.

institutional_event_engagement_time_msec: Time in milliseconds the page was in the foreground since the previous engagement event.

institutional_event_entrances: Equals 1 when the page view is the first page of the session (landing page).

institutional_event_percent_scrolled: Percentage of the page scrolled, set on scroll events. Always 90: GA4 sends the scroll event once the user reaches 90% of the page.

institutional_event_engaged_session_event: Equals 1 when the event belongs to an engaged session.

institutional_event_session_engaged: '1' when the session is engaged (lasted more than 10 seconds, had 2+ page views or a key event), '0' otherwise.

institutional_event_page_title: Title of the page on which the event occurred.

institutional_event_origin: Path of the page on which the event occurred, sent by the institutional website tracking plan.

institutional_event_source: Source of the marketing campaign that generated the session (utm_source).

institutional_event_medium: Medium of the marketing campaign that generated the session (utm_medium).

institutional_event_campaign: Name of the marketing campaign that generated the session (utm_campaign).

institutional_event_term: Paid search keyword of the marketing campaign that generated the session (utm_term).

institutional_event_ignore_referrer: Equals 'true' when the referrer is ignored for attribution (internal or excluded referral).

institutional_event_link_url: URL of the clicked link, set on outbound click and file_download events.

institutional_event_link_domain: Domain of the clicked outbound link.

institutional_event_link_text: Text of the clicked link, set on file_download events.

institutional_event_link_classes: CSS classes of the clicked link element.

institutional_event_outbound: Equals 'true' when the clicked link leads to another domain.

institutional_event_file_name: Path of the downloaded file, set on file_download events.

institutional_event_file_extension: Extension of the downloaded file, set on file_download events.

institutional_event_privacy_consent_type: Consent flag sent with the cookie banner answer ('true' or 'false'), set on consent.answer events.

institutional_event_privacy_consent_value: Answer given by the user to the cookie banner ('full' or 'refusal'), set on consent.answer events.

docs.title: Column  native consultation
docs.text:
Note

This file is auto-generated

Work in progress

consultation_id: The unique identifier for each consultation event.

consultation_date: The date on which the consultation took place.

consultation_macro_origin: The macro origin of the consultation, indicating the broader context of its initiation : search, home, similar_offer, deeplink..

consultation_micro_origin: The micro origin of the consultation, which provides more granular information on the canal : type of home, type of research, origin of venue consultation which stems from offer consultation...

docs.title: Column  native daily item viewed
docs.text:
native_daily_item_viewed_event_date: Date of the view. Partition column: a partition filter is required. Data starts on 2025-06-02 (trackers partial before 2025-11-01) and each run loads the day three days back, so the most recent days are not yet available.

native_daily_item_viewed_origin: App channel (screen) where the item was displayed, from the raw Firebase origin parameter: new values can appear with app versions. Can be NULL.

native_daily_item_viewed_module_id: Contentful identifier of the module (block) that displayed the item; NULL outside a module.

native_daily_item_viewed_home_entry_id: Contentful entry identifier of the home where the item was displayed; NULL outside the home.

native_daily_item_viewed_playlist_name: Name of the module (Contentful title, or offer title when there is none) identified by module_id; NULL when the module has no Contentful tag.

native_daily_item_viewed_playlist_offer_category: Offer categories the module is tagged with in Contentful (tag 'categorie_offre'), several values joined with ' , '.

native_daily_item_viewed_item_type: Type of the displayed item: 'offer' (viewed_item_id is an offer_id), 'venue' (viewed_item_id is a venue_id), and other types such as 'artist'.

native_daily_item_viewed_viewed_item_id: Identifier of the displayed item: an offer_id when item_type = 'offer', a venue_id when item_type = 'venue', an artist_id when item_type = 'artist'.

native_daily_item_viewed_user_role: Role of the user from the applicative user table when the day was processed (about three days after the view): 'BENEFICIARY', 'UNDERAGE_BENEFICIARY', 'FREE_BENEFICIARY'; NULL for general public, other roles or users not logged in.

native_daily_item_viewed_total_user_item_viewed: Number of distinct users who saw the item that day for the row's channel, module and user attributes, summed over the four display-position buckets (a user seeing the item in two position buckets counts twice).

native_daily_item_viewed_total_user_item_viewed_bucket_1_3: Number of distinct logged-in users who saw the item in positions 1 to 3 of its module (item index 0 to 2) that day, for the row's attributes.

native_daily_item_viewed_total_user_item_viewed_bucket_4_6: Number of distinct logged-in users who saw the item in positions 4 to 6 of its module (item index 3 to 5) that day, for the row's attributes.

native_daily_item_viewed_total_user_item_viewed_bucket_7_9: Number of distinct logged-in users who saw the item in positions 7 to 9 of its module (item index 6 to 8) that day, for the row's attributes.

native_daily_item_viewed_total_user_item_viewed_bucket_10_plus: Number of distinct logged-in users who saw the item in position 10 or beyond of its module (item index 9 or more) that day, for the row's attributes. Also counts views with an unknown position (index -1).

docs.title: Column  native event
docs.text:
firebase_screen: The name of the screen where the event occurred, providing context for the event.

user_location_type: The type of geolocation used by the user during the session (via geolocation data, manually entered by the user, or information unavailable).

booking_cancellation_step: The step in the booking cancellation process, if applicable.

onboarding_user_selected_age: The age selected by the user during onboarding.

docs.title: Column  native event flattened
docs.text:
native_event_flattened_event_date: Date of the Firebase event. Partition column: a partition filter is required (the table holds several terabytes).

native_event_flattened_user_id: Identifier of the logged-in pass Culture account that emitted the event; NULL when the user is not logged in. Use it, not user_pseudo_id, to count people.

native_event_flattened_user_pseudo_id: Firebase app-instance (device) pseudo identifier. One person can have several; it does not identify a person.

native_event_flattened_event_name: Raw Firebase event name (e.g. 'ModuleDisplayedOnHomePage', 'screen_view', 'user_engagement', 'ViewItem', 'ConsultHome', 'PerformSearch', 'ConsultOffer', 'session_start'). All events are kept except repeated 'ConsultOffer' on the same offer within 3 seconds in the same session, which are deduplicated.

native_event_flattened_event_previous_timestamp: Time at which the same event was previously logged by this app instance (Firebase event_previous_timestamp, converted from microseconds).

native_event_flattened_user_first_touch_timestamp: Timestamp of the first time the user opened the app on this app instance (Firebase user_first_touch_timestamp). Partitions built before the October 2026 fix hold the event timestamp instead.

native_event_flattened_platform: Platform that emitted the event. Stored values: 'IOS', 'ANDROID', 'WEB'.

native_event_flattened_double_offer_id: Value of the offerId event parameter when the app sent it as a double; NULL otherwise. The string and integer forms of the parameter are in offerId.

native_event_flattened_ga_session_id: Firebase session identifier, unique only within a device: the unique session key is the pair (user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id).

native_event_flattened_should_use_algolia_recommend: Integer value of the Firebase event parameter shouldUseAlgoliaRecommend: flag telling whether the module relied on Algolia Recommend for its recommendations (1 = yes).

native_event_flattened_search_is_autocomplete: On 'PerformSearch', 1 when the search was launched from an autocomplete suggestion; NULL otherwise (the app only sends the parameter when it is true).

native_event_flattened_search_is_based_on_history: On 'PerformSearch', 1 when the search was launched from the user's search history; NULL otherwise (the app only sends the parameter when it is true).

native_event_flattened_search_offer_is_duo: On 'PerformSearch', 1 when the 'Duo' filter (offers bookable for two people) is on; NULL otherwise (the app only sends the parameter when it is true).

native_event_flattened_geo_located: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: 1 when the recommendation was computed with the user's location, 0 otherwise. Merges the geoLocated and geo_located event parameters.

native_event_flattened_enabled: On 'ChangeOrientationToggle', the new state of the screen orientation toggle: 1 when enabled, 0 when disabled.

native_event_flattened_search_id: Identifier of a search. One search emits several 'PerformSearch' events as filters change, all sharing the same searchId. NULL on a small share of events.

native_event_flattened_module_id: Identifier of the home module (block) carried by the event, when relevant.

native_event_flattened_playlist_type: Type of the offer playlist the event comes from, e.g. 'sameCategorySimilarOffers', 'otherCategoriesSimilarOffers', 'booksSameCategorySimilarOffers', 'sameArtistPlaylist', 'artistTopOffers', 'searchResults'.

native_event_flattened_entry_id: Contentful entry identifier carried by the event: the home or block on which the event happened (e.g. on 'ViewItem', 'CategoryBlockClicked', 'HighlightBlockClicked').

native_event_flattened_home_entry_id: Contentful entry identifier of the home on which the event happened, sent on home events such as 'ConsultHome', 'ModuleDisplayedOnHomePage' or 'SeeAllClicked'.

native_event_flattened_step: Funnel step parameter. On 'CancelBookingFunnel', the booking modal step the user closed; the signup and identity-check funnel events carry their own step names in the same column.

native_event_flattened_search_genre_types: On 'PerformSearch', the genre filters selected (e.g. book or music genres), as a JSON array in a string.

native_event_flattened_search_location_filter: On 'PerformSearch', the location filter as a JSON string: the location type and, for a place or a venue, its label (truncated so that the parameter stays within 100 characters).

native_event_flattened_age: Age chosen or entered by the user, sent on onboarding and sign-up events such as 'SelectAge' or 'SignUpTooYoung'.

native_event_flattened_search_categories: On 'PerformSearch', the category filters selected, as a JSON array in a string.

native_event_flattened_firebase_screen: Name of the screen displayed, set on 'screen_view' events.

native_event_flattened_firebase_previous_screen: Name of the screen displayed before firebase_screen, set on 'screen_view' events.

native_event_flattened_page_name: Name of the page the event refers to, e.g. on 'CancelSignup' the sign-up page the user left.

native_event_flattened_offer_id: Identifier of the offer carried by the event (consultation, booking, favorite...).

native_event_flattened_query: Firebase event parameter query: the search text sent by search events other than 'PerformSearch', such as 'NoSearchResult'. On 'PerformSearch' the text is in searchQuery.

native_event_flattened_search_query: Text typed by the user for a search ('PerformSearch'); NULL for a search without text (category or location filters only).

native_event_flattened_category_name: Name of the offer category sent with club and review events, such as 'ClickAllClubRecos', 'ClickWhatsClub' or 'ClickInfoReview'.

native_event_flattened_type: Generic Firebase event parameter type, whose meaning depends on the event: the shared content on 'Share' ('Artist', 'Offer', 'Venue', 'App'), the kind of list on 'SeeAllClicked' ('offers', 'venues', 'artists', 'categories'), the block on 'SystemBlockDisplayed', the filter type on search filter events, etc.

native_event_flattened_venue_id: Identifier of the venue carried by the event.

native_event_flattened_booking_id: Identifier of the confirmed booking, set on 'BookingConfirmation' events; matches booking_id in the applicative booking tables.

native_event_flattened_from_offer_id: Identifier of the offer whose playlist (similar offers) the user came from, set when an offer is consulted or booked from such a playlist; see playlistType.

native_event_flattened_filter_types: Firebase event parameter filterTypes: the types of search filters applied, as sent by the app.

native_event_flattened_filter: Firebase event parameter filter: the search filter the event refers to, as sent by the app.

native_event_flattened_search_date: On 'PerformSearch', the date filter as a JSON string with startDate, endDate and searchFilter (the date option chosen, 'dateInterval' or 'specificDate').

native_event_flattened_search_max_price: On 'PerformSearch', the maximum price filter, as a string; NULL when no maximum price is set.

native_event_flattened_search_native_categories: On 'PerformSearch', the native category filters selected (sub-levels of the categories), as a JSON array in a string.

native_event_flattened_module_list_id: On 'CategoryBlockClicked' and 'TrendsBlockClicked', the identifier of the list module that contains the clicked block.

native_event_flattened_index: Position sent with the event: on 'ModuleDisplayedOnHomePage', the position of the module on the home; on 'ViewItem', the position of the playlist on the page.

native_event_flattened_traffic_gen: utm_gen parameter of the marketing link that opened the app, attached by the app to the following events (only when the user accepted the marketing cookies).

native_event_flattened_traffic_content: utm_content parameter of the marketing link that opened the app, attached by the app to the following events (only when the user accepted the marketing cookies).

native_event_flattened_to_entry_id: On 'CategoryBlockClicked', 'TrendsBlockClicked' and 'HighlightBlockClicked', the Contentful entry identifier of the page (thematic home) opened by the click.

native_event_flattened_reco_origin: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: origin of the recommendation. Merges the recoOrigin and reco_origin event parameters.

native_event_flattened_ab_test: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: the A/B test group of the recommendation call. Merges the abTest and ab_test event parameters.

native_event_flattened_model_version: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: version of the recommendation model. Merges the modelVersion and model_version event parameters.

native_event_flattened_model_name: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: name of the recommendation model. Merges the modelName and model_name event parameters.

native_event_flattened_model_endpoint: Recommendation API parameter sent with recommendation modules: endpoint of the recommendation model that served the call. Merges the modelEndpoint and model_endpoint event parameters.

native_event_flattened_user_status: Firebase event parameter userStatus: the status chosen by the user during onboarding, as sent by the app.

native_event_flattened_social: On 'Share', the social network or share channel chosen by the user ('Other' when not listed).

native_event_flattened_search_view: On 'PerformSearch', the search screen the search was made from.

native_event_flattened_duration: On 'VenueMapSeenDuration' and 'VenueMapSessionDuration', the time spent on the venue map, in seconds (as a string).

native_event_flattened_appsflyer_user_id: AppsFlyer identifier of the app install, sent with the event to link Firebase and AppsFlyer data.

native_event_flattened_accessibility_filter: On 'PerformSearch', the accessibility filters as a JSON string with the keys 'Audio', 'Mental', 'Motor' and 'Visual' (true or false).

native_event_flattened_video_duration: Total duration of the video, in seconds (as a string), sent with video events such as 'HasSeenAllVideo' and 'HasDismissedModal'.

native_event_flattened_seen_duration: Time of the video watched by the user, in seconds (as a string), sent with video events such as 'HasSeenAllVideo' and 'HasDismissedModal'.

native_event_flattened_youtube_id: YouTube identifier of the video, sent with video events such as 'ConsultVideo' and 'HasSeenAllVideo'.

native_event_flattened_origin: Where the event was triggered from in the app: the from event parameter, or the origin parameter when from is absent (on 'ViewItem', the page in lower case, e.g. 'home', 'searchresults', 'venue').

native_event_flattened_displayed_offers: On 'ModuleDisplayedOnHomePage', identifiers of the offers displayed in the module, rebuilt as an array from the offers_1_10 to offers_41_50 parameters (first 50 offers at most); empty array when none.

native_event_flattened_displayed_venues: On 'ModuleDisplayedOnHomePage', identifiers of the venues displayed in the module, rebuilt as an array from the venues_1_10 to venues_41_50 parameters (first 50 venues at most); empty array when none.

native_event_flattened_from_multivenue_offer_id: Identifier of the multi-venue offer from which the user selected the offer of another venue; set on 'ConsultOffer'.

native_event_flattened_is_anomaly: TRUE for technically inconsistent events: 'BookingConfirmation' without bookingId or without user_id, and 'ConsultOffer' without offerId.

native_event_flattened_is_headline: On 'ConsultOffer', 'true' when the consulted offer is the headline offer of its venue, 'false' otherwise.

native_event_flattened_items_0: On 'ViewItem', the first chunk of the displayed items, as 'position:item_id' pairs separated by commas (100 characters at most; position -1 when unknown). Only this first chunk is extracted: the items sent in the following chunks (items_1, ...) are not in this table.

native_event_flattened_item_type: On 'ViewItem', the type of the displayed items.

native_event_flattened_theme_setting: On 'UpdateAppTheme' and 'AppThemeStatus', the theme chosen in the app settings (e.g. 'light', 'dark').

native_event_flattened_system_theme: On 'UpdateAppTheme' and 'AppThemeStatus', the theme of the device system (e.g. 'light', 'dark').

native_event_flattened_legacy_geo_located: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the geoLocated parameter is now merged into geo_located.

native_event_flattened_legacy_call_id: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the callId parameter is now merged into call_id.

native_event_flattened_legacy_reco_origin: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the recoOrigin parameter is now merged into reco_origin.

native_event_flattened_legacy_ab_test: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the abTest parameter is now merged into ab_test.

native_event_flattened_legacy_model_version: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the modelVersion parameter is now merged into model_version.

native_event_flattened_legacy_model_name: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the modelName parameter is now merged into model_name.

native_event_flattened_legacy_model_endpoint: Legacy column from an earlier version of the model, no longer filled: the modelEndpoint parameter is now merged into model_endpoint.

native_event_flattened_feature_name: Name of the feature the event refers to, on feature feedback and fake door events ('FeatureFeedbackClicked', 'HasClickedFakeDoorCTA').

native_event_flattened_feedback_response: On 'FeatureFeedbackClicked', the user's answer to the feature feedback question: 'Oui' or 'Non'.

native_event_flattened_origin_details: Detail completing origin on where the event was triggered from, e.g. on 'ConsultArtist', 'ConsultAdvice' or 'HasClickedFakeDoorCTA'.

native_event_flattened_advice_type: Type of advice (recommendation written by a club or a partner) the event refers to: 'book_club', 'cine_club', 'scene_club' or 'pro'.

native_event_flattened_origin_detail: On 'HasExitedActivationFlow', the call to action the user clicked to leave the activation flow.

native_event_flattened_code: Firebase code parameter. On BookingError, the API error that blocked the booking: 'ALREADY_BOOKED', 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT', 'STOCK_NOT_BOOKABLE', 'PROVIDER_STOCK_NOT_ENOUGH_SEATS', 'PROVIDER_SHOW_DOES_NOT_EXIST', 'PROVIDER_BOOKING_TIMEOUT'. Populated since 2026-07-05, NULL before.

native_event_flattened_displayed_on: On 'ModuleDisplayed', the page on which the module was displayed (e.g. 'artist').

native_event_flattened_map_type: Firebase event parameter mapType: the type of map the event refers to, as sent by the app.

docs.title: Ministry exports
docs.text:
This section documents the exp_ministry export tables with one dedicated page per main table family.

Each page provides table definitions, join keys, and practical pseudo-SQL examples to calculate operational indicators.

docs.title: Main table pages
docs.text: Page Main tables covered Focus User and deposits exp_ministry__user, exp_ministry__deposit Beneficiary lifecycle and credit stock Bookings exp_ministry__booking (+ links to user/offer/stock keys) Consumption, statuses, and transaction KPIs Offers and stocks exp_ministry__offer, exp_ministry__stock, exp_ministry__offer_metadata Supply catalog and availability Offerers and venues exp_ministry__offerer, exp_ministry__venue Cultural actor and place network Geography tables exp_ministry__address, exp_ministry__user_address, exp_ministry__venue_address, exp_ministry__offerer_representation_address, exp_ministry__geo_iris Territorial segmentation and joins

docs.title: Calculating global indicators from ministry exports
docs.text: The examples below show how to compute key operational indicators directly from the raw export tables.

docs.title: 1. Ever-credited beneficiaries
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d.deposit_creation_date, MONTH) AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS total_beneficiaries
FROM exp_ministry__deposit AS d
INNER JOIN exp_ministry__user AS u ON u.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE d.deposit_type <> 'GRANT_FREE'
  AND (u.user_is_active = TRUE OR u.user_suspension_reason = 'upon user request')
GROUP BY cohort_month
ORDER BY cohort_month;

docs.title: 2. Active beneficiaries at month-end
docs.text:
Proxy: credit not expired at snapshot date. Does not check whether the credit balance is fully spent.

WITH month_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC(day, MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS snapshot_date
    FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2021-01-01', CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS day
)
SELECT
    m.snapshot_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS active_beneficiaries
FROM month_end AS m
JOIN exp_ministry__deposit AS d
    ON d.deposit_creation_date <= m.snapshot_date
    AND d.deposit_expiration_date >= m.snapshot_date
JOIN exp_ministry__user AS u ON u.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE d.deposit_type <> 'GRANT_FREE'
  AND (u.user_is_active = TRUE OR u.user_suspension_reason = 'upon user request')
GROUP BY m.snapshot_date
ORDER BY m.snapshot_date;

docs.title: 3. Booking volume and revenue
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(b.booking_creation_date, MONTH) AS partition_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(b.booking_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM exp_ministry__booking AS b
WHERE b.booking_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')
GROUP BY partition_month
ORDER BY partition_month;

docs.title: 4. Booking metrics by territory
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(b.booking_creation_date, MONTH) AS partition_month,
    ua.user_region_name,
    ua.user_department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(b.booking_amount) AS total_booking_amount
FROM exp_ministry__booking AS b
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__user_address AS ua
    ON ua.user_id = b.user_id
WHERE b.booking_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')
GROUP BY partition_month, ua.user_region_name, ua.user_department_code
ORDER BY partition_month;

docs.title: 5. Coverage numerator by age cohort
docs.text:
For the denominator (eligible population by age), see INSEE population data. The INSEE population series covers ages 16–19; age 20 beneficiaries have no matching denominator for the coverage rate.

milestone_age = exact age at first deposit activation (accounts for birthday not yet reached in that calendar year). The canonical vidoc definition computes age from monthly birth-cohort matching over each active-deposit day; this query is a snapshot-at-activation proxy.

WITH eligible_users AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        DATE_DIFF(user_first_deposit_creation_date, user_birth_date, YEAR)
        - IF(
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM user_birth_date) * 100 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM user_birth_date)
            > EXTRACT(MONTH FROM user_first_deposit_creation_date) * 100
              + EXTRACT(DAY FROM user_first_deposit_creation_date),
            1, 0
        ) AS milestone_age
    FROM exp_ministry__user
    WHERE user_first_deposit_creation_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    milestone_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_beneficiaries
FROM eligible_users
WHERE milestone_age IN (16, 17, 18, 19, 20)
GROUP BY milestone_age
ORDER BY milestone_age;

docs.title: 6. Diversity: beneficiaries with 3+ categories
docs.text:
Scope: beneficiaries with an expired age-18 credit (GRANT_18 or GRANT_17_18). Bookings across all credits (ages 15–20) are counted. Only validated bookings (booking_used_date IS NOT NULL) are counted, matching the canonical vidoc definition.

WITH expired_age18_beneficiaries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.user_id
    FROM exp_ministry__deposit AS d
    WHERE d.deposit_type IN ('GRANT_18', 'GRANT_17_18')
      AND d.deposit_expiration_date < CURRENT_DATE()
),
user_categories AS (
    SELECT
        b.user_id,
        o.offer_category
    FROM exp_ministry__booking AS b
    JOIN exp_ministry__offer AS o ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id
    WHERE b.booking_used_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.user_id, o.offer_category
),
user_diversity AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT offer_category) AS category_count
    FROM user_categories
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNTIF(ud.category_count >= 3) AS beneficiaries_with_3plus_categories,
    COUNT(*) AS total_beneficiaries,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(ud.category_count >= 3), COUNT(*)) AS diversity_rate
FROM expired_age18_beneficiaries AS eb
LEFT JOIN user_diversity AS ud ON ud.user_id = eb.user_id;

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Main table:

  • exp_ministry__booking

Core linked tables:

  • exp_ministry__user
  • exp_ministry__offer
  • exp_ministry__stock
  • exp_ministry__user_address

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
A booking is one transaction line identified by booking_id.

Main business fields:

  • booking_creation_date
  • booking_amount
  • booking_quantity
  • booking_status
  • booking_cancellation_date, booking_cancellation_reason

Main foreign keys:

  • user_id, deposit_id, stock_id, offer_id, venue_id, offerer_id

docs.title: Grain and keys
docs.text:
• One row per booking_id.
  • Time analyses are usually done with DATE_TRUNC(booking_creation_date, MONTH).

docs.title: Booking volume and amount by month
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(booking_creation_date, MONTH) AS partition_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(booking_amount) AS total_booking_amount
FROM exp_ministry__booking
WHERE booking_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')
GROUP BY partition_month
ORDER BY partition_month;

docs.title: Booking amount by region and department
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(b.booking_creation_date, MONTH) AS partition_month,
    ua.user_region_name,
    ua.user_department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(b.booking_amount) AS total_booking_amount
FROM exp_ministry__booking AS b
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__user_address AS ua
    ON ua.user_id = b.user_id
WHERE b.booking_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')
GROUP BY partition_month, ua.user_region_name, ua.user_department_code
ORDER BY partition_month;

docs.title: Mean basket and cancellation rate
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(booking_creation_date, MONTH) AS partition_month,
    AVG(booking_amount) AS avg_booking_amount,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COUNTIF(booking_status = 'CANCELLED'),
        COUNT(*)
    ) AS cancellation_rate
FROM exp_ministry__booking
GROUP BY partition_month
ORDER BY partition_month;

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Main tables:

  • exp_ministry__address
  • exp_ministry__user_address
  • exp_ministry__venue_address
  • exp_ministry__offerer_representation_address
  • exp_ministry__geo_iris

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
These tables provide territorial dimensions for analyses by region, department, QPV, and IRIS.

  • User geography: exp_ministry__user_address (residence context for beneficiaries).
  • Venue geography: exp_ministry__venue_address (location context for cultural supply).
  • Offerer representation address: administrative location of organizations.
  • exp_ministry__geo_iris: IRIS referential with geometry.

docs.title: Grain and keys
docs.text:
• exp_ministry__address: one row per address_id.
  • exp_ministry__user_address: one row per user_id.
  • exp_ministry__venue_address: one row per venue_id.
  • exp_ministry__offerer_representation_address: one row per offerer-address link.
  • exp_ministry__geo_iris: one row per iris_internal_id.

docs.title: Common joins
docs.text:
SELECT
    ua.user_id,
    ua.user_region_name,
    ua.user_department_code,
    ua.user_qpv_code,
    gi.iris_code,
    gi.iris_label
FROM exp_ministry__user_address AS ua
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__geo_iris AS gi
    ON gi.iris_internal_id = ua.user_iris_internal_id;

docs.title: Beneficiary and booking concentration by territory
docs.text:
SELECT
    ua.user_region_name,
    ua.user_department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ua.user_id) AS total_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(b.booking_amount) AS total_booking_amount
FROM exp_ministry__user_address AS ua
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__booking AS b
    ON b.user_id = ua.user_id
GROUP BY ua.user_region_name, ua.user_department_code
ORDER BY total_booking_amount DESC;

docs.title: QPV share among active users
docs.text:
SELECT
    COUNTIF(ua.user_qpv_code IS NOT NULL) AS users_in_qpv,
    COUNT(*) AS total_users,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(ua.user_qpv_code IS NOT NULL), COUNT(*)) AS qpv_share
FROM exp_ministry__user_address AS ua;

docs.title: Supply coverage by venue geography
docs.text:
SELECT
    va.venue_region_name,
    va.venue_department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT va.venue_id) AS total_venues,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.offer_id) AS total_offers
FROM exp_ministry__venue_address AS va
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__offer AS o
    ON o.venue_id = va.venue_id
GROUP BY va.venue_region_name, va.venue_department_code
ORDER BY total_offers DESC;

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Main tables:

  • exp_ministry__offer
  • exp_ministry__stock
  • exp_ministry__offer_metadata

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
• exp_ministry__offer describes the cultural proposition (catalog layer).
  • exp_ministry__stock describes sellable availability and price (commercial layer).
  • exp_ministry__offer_metadata provides optional content enrichment (movie/book/taxonomy fields).

docs.title: Grain and keys
docs.text:
• exp_ministry__offer: one row per offer_id.
  • exp_ministry__stock: one row per stock_id.
  • exp_ministry__offer_metadata: one row per offer_id when metadata exists.
  • Main join key: offer_id.

docs.title: Common joins
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offer_id,
    o.offer_category,
    o.offer_subcategory,
    o.offer_is_bookable,
    o.offer_is_active,
    s.stock_id,
    s.stock_price,
    s.stock_quantity,
    s.stock_booking_limit_date
FROM exp_ministry__offer AS o
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__stock AS s
    ON s.offer_id = o.offer_id;

docs.title: Active supply by category
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offer_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.offer_id) AS total_offers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.stock_id) AS total_stocks
FROM exp_ministry__offer AS o
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__stock AS s
    ON s.offer_id = o.offer_id
WHERE o.offer_is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY o.offer_category
ORDER BY total_offers DESC;

docs.title: Price distribution by category
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offer_category,
    AVG(s.stock_price) AS avg_price,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(s.stock_price, 4)[OFFSET(2)] AS median_price
FROM exp_ministry__offer AS o
JOIN exp_ministry__stock AS s
    ON s.offer_id = o.offer_id
WHERE s.stock_price IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.offer_category;

docs.title: Metadata coverage
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offer_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.offer_id) AS total_offers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT om.offer_id) AS offers_with_metadata,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT om.offer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT o.offer_id)) AS metadata_coverage_rate
FROM exp_ministry__offer AS o
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__offer_metadata AS om
    ON om.offer_id = o.offer_id
GROUP BY o.offer_category;

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Main tables:

  • exp_ministry__offerer
  • exp_ministry__venue

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
• An offerer is a cultural organization (offerer_id, legal identity fields).
  • A venue is an operational place managed by an offerer (venue_id, offerer_id).
  • The pair supports network analyses: organization footprint, validation status, and activity.

docs.title: Grain and keys
docs.text:
• exp_ministry__offerer: one row per offerer_id.
  • exp_ministry__venue: one row per venue_id.
  • Main relationship: venue.offerer_id = offerer.offerer_id.

docs.title: Common joins
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offerer_id,
    o.offerer_name,
    o.offerer_siren,
    o.offerer_validation_status,
    v.venue_id,
    v.venue_name,
    v.venue_type_label
FROM exp_ministry__offerer AS o
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__venue AS v
    ON v.offerer_id = o.offerer_id;

docs.title: Offerers and venue footprint
docs.text:
SELECT
    o.offerer_validation_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.offerer_id) AS total_offerers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.venue_id) AS total_venues
FROM exp_ministry__offerer AS o
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__venue AS v
    ON v.offerer_id = o.offerer_id
GROUP BY o.offerer_validation_status;

docs.title: Venue activity proxy from bookings
docs.text:
SELECT
    v.venue_id,
    v.venue_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
    SUM(b.booking_amount) AS total_booking_amount
FROM exp_ministry__venue AS v
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__booking AS b
    ON b.venue_id = v.venue_id
GROUP BY v.venue_id, v.venue_name
ORDER BY total_booking_amount DESC;

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Main tables:

  • exp_ministry__user
  • exp_ministry__deposit

These tables are the basis for beneficiary stock and credit lifecycle analyses.

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text:
• A beneficiary is represented by user_id in exp_ministry__user.
  • Credits are represented by deposit_id in exp_ministry__deposit, linked through user_id.
  • A user can have multiple deposits over time (initial credit and recredits).

docs.title: Grain and keys
docs.text:
• exp_ministry__user: one row per user_id.
  • exp_ministry__deposit: one row per deposit_id.
  • Main join key: user_id.

docs.title: Common joins
docs.text:
SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.user_age,
    u.user_is_current_beneficiary,
    d.deposit_id,
    d.deposit_amount,
    d.deposit_creation_date,
    d.deposit_expiration_date,
    d.deposit_type
FROM exp_ministry__user AS u
LEFT JOIN exp_ministry__deposit AS d
    ON d.user_id = u.user_id;

docs.title: Ever-credited beneficiaries
docs.text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d.deposit_creation_date, MONTH) AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS total_ever_credited_beneficiaries
FROM exp_ministry__deposit AS d
INNER JOIN exp_ministry__user AS u ON u.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE d.deposit_type <> 'GRANT_FREE'
  AND (u.user_is_active = TRUE OR u.user_suspension_reason = 'upon user request')
GROUP BY cohort_month
ORDER BY cohort_month;

docs.title: Active beneficiaries at month-end (raw proxy)
docs.text:
Proxy: credit not expired at snapshot date. Does not check whether the credit balance is fully spent.

WITH month_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC(day, MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS snapshot_date
    FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2021-01-01', CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS day
)
SELECT
    m.snapshot_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_id) AS active_beneficiaries
FROM month_end AS m
JOIN exp_ministry__deposit AS d
    ON d.deposit_creation_date <= m.snapshot_date
    AND d.deposit_expiration_date >= m.snapshot_date
JOIN exp_ministry__user AS u ON u.user_id = d.user_id
WHERE d.deposit_type <> 'GRANT_FREE'
  AND (u.user_is_active = TRUE OR u.user_suspension_reason = 'upon user request')
GROUP BY m.snapshot_date
ORDER BY m.snapshot_date;

docs.title: Coverage numerator by milestone age
docs.text:
milestone_age = exact age at first deposit activation (accounts for birthday not yet reached in that calendar year). The canonical vidoc definition computes age from monthly birth-cohort matching over each active-deposit day; this query is a snapshot-at-activation proxy. The INSEE population denominator covers ages 16–19; age 20 beneficiaries have no matching denominator for the coverage rate.

WITH eligible_users AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        DATE_DIFF(user_first_deposit_creation_date, user_birth_date, YEAR)
        - IF(
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM user_birth_date) * 100 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM user_birth_date)
            > EXTRACT(MONTH FROM user_first_deposit_creation_date) * 100
              + EXTRACT(DAY FROM user_first_deposit_creation_date),
            1, 0
        ) AS milestone_age
    FROM exp_ministry__user
    WHERE user_first_deposit_creation_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    milestone_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total_beneficiaries
FROM eligible_users
WHERE milestone_age IN (16, 17, 18, 19, 20)
GROUP BY milestone_age
ORDER BY milestone_age;

The product_delta table contains the list of products (identified by EAN) and their parsed data that must be synchronized with the backend application.

This model specifically filters for products where the support code contains alphabetic characters, to targeting physical books.

docs.title: Key Concepts
docs.text:
• Delta Generation: This table is regenerated daily based on the snapshot history and the last successful synchronization timestamp recorded in local_provider_event.
  • Target Consumer: Primarily used by the backend system to perform incremental updates (UPSERTs) on its product database.

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text: This section would typically display the auto-generated schema from dbt docs.

docs.title: Column Descriptions
docs.text:
ean: EAN (European Article Number): The unique identifier for the product. It serves as the primary key for joining and identifying products across systems.

title: Title: The title of the product (e.g., book title), extracted from the raw JSON payload.

description: Summary: The product's summary or description, extracted from $.article[0].resume. This field can be null.

support_code: Support Code: The code indicating the product's format (e.g., 'T', 'CD', 'P'). Extracted from $.article[0].codesupport.

publication_date: Publication Date: The date the product was published, as a string. Extracted from $.article[0].dateparution. This field can be null.

publisher: Publisher: The name of the publisher. Extracted from $.article[0].editeur. This field can be null.

language_iso: ISO Language Code: The ISO code for the product's language (e.g., 'eng'). Extracted from $.article[0].langueiso. This field can be null.

vat_rate: VAT Rate: The applicable VAT (TVA) rate for the product, as a string. Extracted from $.article[0].taux_tva. This field can be null.

price: Price: The product's price, cast to a NUMERIC type. Extracted from $.article[0].prix. This field can be null.

readership_id: Readership ID: The identifier for the target audience (readership), cast to INT64. Extracted from $.article[0].id_lectorat. This field can be null.

gtl: GTL (Genre Titelive): A JSON object containing classification codes. Extracted from $.article[0].gtl.

multiple_authors: Authors (Multiple): A JSON string/array/object containing information about the author(s). Extracted from $.auteurs_multi.

recto_uuid: Front Cover Image UUID: The UUID of the front cover (recto) image associated with the product snapshot.

verso_uuid: Back Cover Image UUID: The UUID of the back cover (verso) image associated with the product snapshot.

image: Front Cover Flag: An integer (e.g., 0 or 1) indicating if a front cover image is available. Extracted from $.article[0].image.

image_4: Back Cover Flag: An integer (e.g., 0 or 1) indicating if a back cover image is available. Extracted from $.article[0].image_4.

modification_date: Modification Date: The timestamp (dbt_valid_from) indicating when this version of the product became active in the source snapshot. This helps trace when the change occurred.

product_type: Product Type: Indicating the type of product. Values can be 'paper' (for books) or 'music' (for CDs/Vinyls), determined by the format of the support code.

artist: Artist: The main artist or band name. Extracted from $.article[0].artiste.

music_label: Music Label: The production label. Extracted from $.article[0].label.

composer: Composer: The composer's name. Extracted from $.article[0].compositeur.

product_performer: Performer: The performer or interpreter. Extracted from $.article[0].interprete.

nb_discs: Number of Discs: The number of physical discs/vinyls included. Extracted from $.article[0].nb_galettes.

comment: Comment: Additional comments or notes regarding the product. Extracted from $.article[0].commentaire.

explicit_content: Explicit Content: Indicator regarding explicit content (e.g., parental advisory). Extracted from $.article[0].explicit.

availability: Availability: The availability (int Enum) status of the product. Extracted from $.article[0].dispo.

distributor: Distributor: The name of the distributor handling the product. Extracted from $.article[0].distributeur.

docs.title: Booking
docs.text:
Table: Booking

This model exports booking data for ministry use. It contains information about beneficiary bookings including:

  • Booking details (ID, creation date, quantity, amount)
  • Booking status and cancellation information
  • Related entities (user, deposit, stock, offer, venue, offerer)
  • Usage information (rank, used date)

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description booking_id STRING Unique identifier for a booking. booking_creation_date Date when the booking was created. booking_quantity INT64 Quantity of offer booked. Can be 1, or 2 if booking was made using the duo option. Summing it counts seats, not bookings. booking_amount Unit price of the booked offer: the amount for one quantity. Multiply by the booking quantity for the booking total. booking_status STRING Current status of the booking. For individual bookings, stored values are 'CONFIRMED' (booked, not yet used), 'USED' (used), 'REIMBURSED' (used and reimbursed to the offerer) and 'CANCELLED'. booking_cancellation_date Date when the booking was cancelled. booking_cancellation_reason Reason for booking cancellation. user_id STRING Unique identifier for a user. deposit_id STRING Unique identifier for the deposit. booking_intermediary_amount NUMERIC The amount of the booking multiplied by the booking quantity. This field is used when we calculate the revenue. booking_rank Rank of the booking in the user's booking history. booking_used_date Date when the booking was used. stock_id STRING Unique identifier for the stock. offer_id STRING Unique identifier for the offer. venue_id STRING Unique identifier for the venue. offerer_id STRING Unique identifier of the offerer.

docs.title: Deposit
docs.text:
Table: Deposit

This model exports deposit data for ministry use. It contains information about user beneficiary deposits including: - Deposit details (ID, amount, type, source) - Temporal information (creation, update, expiration dates) - User association - Recredit information (total recredit and amount) - User creation timing information

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description deposit_id STRING Unique identifier for the deposit. deposit_amount NUMERIC Amount credited on the deposit, in euros, age recredits included and balance transferred from a previous deposit excluded. Varies by deposit_type: GRANT_15_17 up to €80 (€20 at 15, €30 at 16, €30 at 17); GRANT_18 €300 before the reform, €500 during the experimental phase; GRANT_17_18 €50 at 17 and €150 at 18; GRANT_FREE €0 (free bookings only). Recredits are already included: do not add total_recredit_amount. user_id STRING Unique identifier for a user. deposit_source Creation source of the deposit. Normalised values: 'EDUCONNECT' (Éducation nationale authentication), 'UBBLE' (remote identity check), 'DMS' (application file imported from Démarches Simplifiées); otherwise the raw source label, e.g. 'Transfer deposit to age_17_18 type' (deposit converted to GRANT_17_18), 'complétion du profil' (GRANT_FREE), or free-text labels of manual grants. deposit_creation_date The date when the deposit was created. deposit_update_date The date when the deposit was last updated (only for GRANT_15_17). deposit_expiration_date The expiration date of the deposit. GRANT_18: 24 months after creation; GRANT_15_17: On the user’s 18th birthday; GRANT_17_18: The day before the user turns 21. deposit_type Type of the deposit, can be GRANT_18, GRANT_15_17, GRANT_17_18, GRANT_FREE. Since the March 2025 reform, new adult credits are issued as GRANT_17_18 (GRANT_18 is pre-reform/legacy): to measure adult-credit conversion across the reform, count GRANT_18 OR GRANT_17_18, not GRANT_18 alone. total_recredit The total number of times the beneficiary received a new recredit. total_recredit_amount Total amount recredited, in euros: age credits (RECREDIT_*) and balance transferred from a previous deposit (PREVIOUS_DEPOSIT). Age recredits are already included in the deposit amount (deposit_amount, or total_deposit_amount at user level), so the two must not be added. days_between_user_creation_and_deposit_creation Total days between user_creation_date (user activated its account) and deposit_creation_date (user received grant).

Use municipality_label for the name of the parent municipality (Paris). district_code The official code of the district (arrondissement) containing the IRIS area. sub_district_code The official code of the sub-district (canton) containing the IRIS area. department_code The official code of the department (département) containing the IRIS area. department_name The official name of the department containing the IRIS area. iris_centroid The geographic point representing the center of the IRIS area. iris_shape The geographic shape data representing the boundaries of the IRIS area.

docs.title: Offer
docs.text:
Table: Offer

This model exports offers data for ministry use. It contains information about individual cultural offers including: - Offer details (ID, name, description, category, subcategory) - Offer characteristics (duo, bookable, digital/physical goods, event) - Temporal information (creation, update, publication dates) - Status information (synchronization, national scope, active status) - Related entities (offerer, venue, product, item) An offer in our model is a set product (identified via an offer_id) sold by a set cultural partner. For exemple, a set book (identified via its EAN) sold by a set cultural partner.

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description offer_id STRING Unique identifier for the offer. offer_is_synchronised Indicates whether the offer is synchronized with API systems and has a product_id. offer_name Name of the offer as it appears in the application. offer_description Offer description (synopsis, further details on the show) as provided by thecultural partner and displayed in app. offer_subcategory Identifier for the subcategory of the offer. Determined by the cultural partner via a list of pre-set options. offer_category Identifier of the offer category, which groups offer subcategories (offer_subcategory_id): the cultural partner picks the subcategory from a predefined list when creating the offer, and the category follows from it. Rows of retired subcategories can carry a retired category. offer_created_at Timestamp when the offer was created. offer_updated_at Timestamp when the offer was last updated. offer_is_duo Indicates if the offer can be booked as a duo. offer_is_bookable Indicates if the offer is bookable. An offer is considered bookable if it meets the following criteria: 1. Stock availability: The offer has non-expired and non-depleted stock. 2. User access: It can be booked by users in the app. 3. Offerer Validation: The offerer who created the offer must be officially validated. offer_is_digital_goods Indicates if the offer includes digital goods. offer_is_physical_goods Indicates if the offer includes physical goods. offer_is_event Indicates if the offer is an event. webapp_url URL to the offer on the web application. offer_url URL to the offer. offer_is_national Indicates if the offer is available nationally. This Information is originally filled by pass Culture teams but is no longer used. It will be decommissioned soon. offer_is_active Indicates if the offer is active (the offer has been deactivated and is no longer visible in app). offerer_address_id The unique identifier for the mapping between an offerer and an address where he created offers. offer_publication_date Publication date of the offer on the app, bookable or not (coming soon). Data available only from July 2025. offer_product_id Identifier for the product associated with the offer. item_id Identifier of the work (item) the offer belongs to, used internally by the data science team; several offers of the same book or film share an item_id. venue_id Unique identifier for the venue. offerer_id Unique identifier of the offerer. offer_validation Current status of the offer validation by internal teams. The offer may be: - "DRAFT" (yet to be published by the cultural partner) - "PENDING" (published, yet to be reviewed by the pass Culture Fraud team) - "VALIDATED" (validated by pass Culture fraud team, ready to be made available to users) - "REJECTED" (rejected and not made available to users)

docs.text: name data_type description user_id Unique identifier for a user. user_activity User's registered activity (student, apprentice, unemployed etc). Registered at first grant deposit and updated when the user applies for its GRANT_18. user_civility Registered civility of the user (male, female). Information collected during registration. user_school_type Type of school the user is enrolled in: Centre de formation apprentis, Collège privé, Collège public, Lycée agricole, Lycée maritime, Lycée militaire, Lycée privé, Lycée public, À domicile (CNED, institut de santé, etc.). user_is_active Boolean. Indicates if the user's account is currently active (the user can access it, irrespective of grant status). An active account is not necessarily a current beneficiary: its credit can be expired or spent. user_age Current age of the user. user_birth_date Birth date of the user. user_first_deposit_creation_date First deposit creation date. user_first_deposit_type Type of the user's first deposit, can be GRANT_18, GRANT_15_17, GRANT_17_18, GRANT_FREE. user_current_deposit_type Type of the user's current deposit. user_created_at Date when the user account was created. user_activated_at Date when the user's account was activated. Corresponds to the first booking date for users in experiment phase, and to user creation date for all users after the experiment phase. user_suspension_reason Reason for the user's suspension. Possible values include: end of eligibility – The user no longer meets the criteria to be eligible for a deposit; fraud suspicion – Suspicious activity detected, requiring investigation; hacking fraud – Confirmed or suspected account compromise; upon user request – The user has explicitly requested the suspension or deletion of their account. NULL when no suspension reason is recorded. user_is_current_beneficiary Boolean. TRUE when the user still has usable credit: their last deposit has not expired, the amount of its used bookings is below the deposit amount, and the account is active. user_seniority Days between user account creation date and current date.

docs.title: User Address
docs.text:
Table: User Address

This model exports beneficiary user address data for ministry use. It contains information about declarative user locations including: The address is the one declared by the beneficiary in their profile, and can be updated by the beneficiary. - Geographic information (latitude, longitude, postal code) - Address details (raw address, geocode type) - Administrative information (academy name, department code, region name) - QPV (Quartier Prioritaire de la Ville) information (code and name) - IRIS internal ID (unique identifier of the IRIS) that can be used to join with the IRIS data provided.

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description user_id Unique identifier for a user. user_address_geocode_type Geocode precision type (street, municipality, etc) of the user's registered address. user_address_raw Raw address of the user's registered address. user_address_latitude Latitude of the user's registered address. user_address_longitude Longitude of the user's registered address. user_academy_name Academy name associated with the user's registered address. user_department_code Department code associated with the user's registered address. user_region_name Region name of the user's registered address. user_qpv_code The official code for the priority urban district (quartier prioritaire de la politique de la ville, QPV). user_qpv_name The name of the priority urban district (QPV). user_postal_code Postal code of the user's registered address. user_iris_internal_id Internal IRIS identifier associated with the user's registered address. docs.title: Venue
docs.text:
Table: Venue

This model exports venue data for ministry use. Venues are defined by a SIRET number. Model contains information about cultural venues including: - Basic information (ID, name, description, public name) - Business information (SIRET number, virtual status) - Temporal information (creation date) - Venue type - Managing offerer association

docs.title: Description  exp qualtrics  beneficiary account
docs.text:
Monthly random sample of pass Culture beneficiary users exported to Qualtrics for NPS reputation indicator surveys.

  • 10,000 users aged 15-17 (GRANT_15_17) and 10,000 aged 18+ (GRANT_18), randomly selected each month
  • Excludes users exported in the previous month
  • Excludes users who have opted out of Qualtrics emails
  • Excludes users who have already answered a survey

Destination: raw_{env}.qualtrics_exported_beneficiary_account (monthly partition, audit) Qualtrics mailing list: "[Import] Indicateur de réputation Jeunes"

docs.title: Description  exp qualtrics  venue account
docs.text:
Monthly random sample of pass Culture cultural venues exported to Qualtrics for NPS reputation indicator surveys.

  • 4,000 venues randomly selected each month

  • Excludes venues whose manager has already answered a survey

Destination: raw_{env}.qualtrics_exported_venue_account (monthly partition, audit) Qualtrics mailing list: "[Import] Indicateur de réputation Acteur Culturel"

docs.title: Beneficiary metrics for vidoc export
docs.text: The exp_vidoc_beneficiary model provides aggregated key indicators related to pass Culture beneficary. It is designed to be exported to ministry for vidoc visualisation.

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text:
Each row represents a key indicator calculated for a specific month, geographic aggregation and beneficiary dimensions level.

Grain: partition_month, region_code, department_code, age_at_calculation, is_in_qpv, macro_density_label, micro_density_label.

total_actual_beneficiaries is a subset of total_beneficiaries (active ⊂ ever-credited). The two are perturbed independently, so the perturbed total_actual_beneficiaries is capped at the perturbed total_beneficiaries of the same row: total_actual ≤ total_beneficiaries holds on every row and at any aggregation level.

name data_type description partition_month Indicates the first day of the month the KPI refers to. region_name The official name of the region containing the IRIS area. region_code The official code of the region (région) containing the IRIS area. department_name The official name of the department containing the IRIS area. department_code The official code of the department (département) containing the IRIS area. age_at_calculation The user's age calculated at the specific reference date of the record (usually the end of the month). Unlike the current age, this value reflects the user's age at the historical point in time represented by the row. is_in_qpv Boolean. TRUE when the user's geocoded address falls inside a priority neighbourhood (QPV). Membership is computed on the geocoded address, not derived from the IRIS: one IRIS can mix addresses in and out of QPVs. macro_density_label Two-class density of the user's registered address, derived from the INSEE municipal density grid: 'urbain' (levels 1 to 4), 'rural' (levels 5 to 7), or 'non localisé' when the address cannot be attached to a municipality. It reflects the user's last known address (geocoded in a full pass in February–March 2025, then re-geocoded as users change address), not necessarily their current residence. micro_density_label String column. Label of the INSEE municipal density grid (grille communale de densité, 7 levels) of the municipality of the user's registered address; 'non localisé' when not located. It reflects the user's last known address (geocoded in a full pass in February–March 2025, then re-geocoded as users change address), not necessarily their current residence. total_actual_beneficiaries The total count of active beneficiaries at the time of calculation. To be included, a user must have a non-expired credit and a remaining amount of credit available for booking. total_beneficiaries Number of beneficiaries at the end of the partition month, broken down by age_at_calculation. Counts every user with an active account (or suspended upon user request) who has ever received credit, regardless of whether the credit is currently active, exhausted, or expired. A user's age_at_calculation is recomputed each month, so the same user can appear in different age buckets across partition_months. Not a true running total — users with deactivated accounts drop from the count.

docs.title: Booking finance individual metrics for vidoc export
docs.text: The exp_vidoc_booking_finance_individual model provides aggregated financial KPIs related to individual bookings. It is designed to be exported to the ministry for vidoc visualisation. Financial KPIs are nullified when statistical secrecy applies (fewer than 3 active cultural partners in the commune for the given month).

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text:
Each row represents financial indicators calculated for a specific month, geographic area, offer category and EPN status.

Grain: partition_month, venue_department_code, venue_epci_code, venue_city_code, offerer_is_epn, offer_category_id.

When is_statistic_secret is TRUE, all financial KPIs (total_bookings, total_quantities, total_revenue_amount, total_reimbursed_amount, total_contribution_amount) are set to NULL.

docs.title: Beneficiary diversity metrics for vidoc export
docs.text: The exp_vidoc_diversity model aggregates key performance indicators on beneficiaries whose credit expired: diversity of bookings (number of categories booked), share of credit spent, amount spent and partners booked. It is designed to be exported to ministry for vidoc visualisation.

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text:
Each row represents a key indicator calculated for a specific month, geographic aggregation and beneficiary dimensions level.

Grain (natural key, one row per combination): deposit_expiration_month, region_code, department_code, is_in_qpv, macro_density_label, micro_density_label.

total_Nplus_category_booked_beneficiaries (N = 1 to 5) and total_spent_share_*_beneficiaries are capped at total_expired_deposit_beneficiaries of the same row, so their shares never exceed 100%.

total_actual_amount_spent_at_expiration and total_distinct_venue_booked_at_expiration are not perturbed: they are null when total_expired_deposit_beneficiaries is below 5. Divide them by total_expired_deposit_beneficiaries to get the average amount spent and the average number of distinct partners booked at expiration.

docs.title: Beneficiary diversity metrics by category for vidoc export
docs.text: The exp_vidoc_diversity__by_category model aggregates key performance indicators to quantify diversity within beneficiary bookings on the pass Culture app, for each offer categories. It is designed to be exported to ministry for vidoc visualisation.

docs.title: Population coverage metrics for vidoc export
docs.text:
The exp_vidoc__population_coverage model aggregates key performance indicators to quantify population coverage at department level. It is designed to be exported to ministry for vidoc visualisation.

Population reference: Coverage indicators are computed against the monthly French population estimation produced by the data-insee-population project. In short, that pipeline takes the 2022 INSEE census as a baseline, projects each birth cohort forward while keeping its geographic distribution stable, anchors totals to INSEE's yearly departmental estimates, and splits cohorts into birth months using regional patterns. Full methodology: method.md.

Related models: - int_seed__monthly_insee_population_estimation — the seed table holding the population estimation used as denominator here. - metrics_population__coverage — upstream metrics model this export is built from.

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text:
Each row represents a key indicator calculated for a specific month and a geographic aggregation level.

Grain: partition_month, birth_month, milestone_age, department_code.

Public INSEE population data — see data-insee-population for details.

name data_type description partition_month Indicates the first day of the month the KPI refers to. birth_month The estimated birth month of individuals based on observed birth trends. milestone_age Age milestone in whole years, used to determine users eligibility: months between birth month and the observation month divided by 12, kept when it is an integer, so milestone_age N is the cohort turning N that month. Stored as INT64 in beneficiary coverage models and in exp_vidoc__population_coverage, STRING in int_kpi__population_coverage and metrics_population__coverage. department_code The official code of the department (département) containing the IRIS area. department_name The official name of the department containing the IRIS area. region_name The official name of the region containing the IRIS area. region_code The official code of the region (région) containing the IRIS area. total_population_last_12_months Rolling sum of french population over the last 12 months for a given age and department.

docs.title: Individual Indicators
docs.text:
The external_reporting__eac model provides aggregated key indicators related to pass Culture government priority politic for the collective part. It is designed for automated export, especially in Excel format.

Collective offer and booking KPIs (external_reporting__eac_offer_booking) are a roll-up of the metrics_offer__collective* and metrics_booking__collective* models. KPIs without suffix follow the venue (cultural partner) geography; KPIs suffixed _etablissements follow the school geography. Use aggregation to combine months: sum flow KPIs, take the last month of stock KPIs.

docs.title: Table Description
docs.text:
Each row represents a key indicator calculated for a specific month and geographic aggregation level. A lexique details the meaning of each kpi_name here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13Epof9MJbtN7srmDIld3-7QN0Hq6WpX7/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113033507472186952579&rtpof=true&sd=true

name data_type description partition_month Indicates the first day of the month the KPI refers to. updated_at The actual date when the data refresh was executed. dimension_name The geographic agregation of the kpi. Can be National, Regional or Departemental. dimension_value The name of the geographic agregation of the kpi, if it exists. (region name, department name) kpi_name The name of the kpi. numerator The numerator of the computed kpi. denominator The denominator of the computed kpi. kpi The value of the kpi. Equals to numerator divided by denominator. scholar_year Scholar year (September to August) the partition_month belongs to. aggregation How to aggregate numerator and denominator over several months: flow = sum the months, stock = take the last month (the value is already scholar year to date, or a snapshot). label Display name of the territory: EPCI or municipality name for EPCI and COM, dimension_value otherwise. intitule Display title of the territory, unique across levels so that it can be used alone as the territory filter: 'Name (code)' for EPCI and COM, 'Région Name' for REG, 'Académie de Name' (or "Académie d'Name") for ACAD, 'Rapport National' for NAT, dimension_value for DEP. is_secret_stat True when the KPI is measured on the cultural partner (venue) geography and the territory (COM, EPCI or DEP) is subject to statistical secrecy at the last complete month, over the 6 or the 48-month rolling window (is_secret_stat of the statistical_secret__cultural_partner models). numerator, denominator and kpi are then NULL on every month. KPIs measured on the beneficiary or school geography are never secret, nor are REG, ACAD and NAT. is_low_count True when the KPI is accounted for by 1 to 4 beneficiaries of the territory over the whole history (see external_reporting__beneficiary_booking_bookers): numerator, denominator and kpi are then NULL on every month. Also true on the months where an average or a share by person (montant_moyen_, pct_beneficiaires_ayant_reserve_) is computed over 1 to 4 beneficiaries. Beneficiary counts are blurred instead (cell key method) and never flagged. is_national_only True on the rows added for a KPI published at NAT but not at this territory level (e.g. coverage rates): numerator, denominator and kpi are NULL, only the national_* columns are filled, so that reports filtered on a territory still show the national value. secret_reason Message to display instead of the KPI when it is masked, whatever the rule (statistical secret on cultural partners, or fewer than 5 beneficiaries behind the KPI): 'Données non disponibles (secret statistique)'. NULL otherwise. is_secret_stat and is_low_count tell the rule apart. secret_detail Internal detail of the rule behind a masked KPI, not to be published: the statistical secret reason of the territory with its side and rolling window (e.g. 'Nombre de partenaires faible (< 3) (individuel, 6 mois)'), or the fewer than 5 beneficiaries rule. docs.title: Transactional native
docs.text:
The int_brevo__transactional_native table event-level data from Brevo, providing insights into user interactions and email campaign performance. Each row represents a specific event associated with a user, linked to a particular email template and categorized with tags. The table contains metrics such as the number of emails delivered, opened, and unsubscribed, enabling a detailed analysis of email engagement.

In addition to email-related metrics, the table provides user-specific engagement data, such as the number of sessions, consultations offered, bookings made, and items marked as favorites in the app. The inclusion of the user_current_deposit_type column allows for segmentation and analysis based on user-specific attributes at the time of the event.

This dataset can be used to monitor the effectiveness of email campaigns, evaluate user behavior, and identify trends or opportunities to enhance engagement strategies.

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description user_id Unique identifier for a user. template_id Brevo template id tag Tag of the brevo transactional email. It allows to identify event_date The date when the event occurred, used for partitioning the data. total_delivered Count of emails successfully delivered to the recipient. total_opened Count of emails opened by the recipient. total_unsubscribed Count of recipients who unsubscribed after receiving the email. user_current_deposit_type Type of the user's current deposit. session_number The number of the session during which the visit occurred, indicating the sequence of user sessions. offer_consultation_number The number of distinct consultation occurences of an offer from home playlists on a given date. booking_number Total number of bookings, both individual and collective. favorites_number Total number of times this offer was favorited.

docs.title: Transactional pro
docs.text:
The int_brevo__transactional_pro table holds event-level data from Brevo for transactional emails sent to cultural partners. Each row represents one recipient (email_id, a hash of the recipient address) of a template and tag, for one offerer and one event day. Counts of delivered, opened and unsubscribed events are summed over every import covering that day. A recipient address linked to several offerers appears once per offerer.

This dataset can be used to monitor the effectiveness of email campaigns, evaluate offerer behavior, and identify trends or opportunities to enhance engagement strategies.

docs.title: Table description
docs.text: name data_type description brevo_tag Tag of the brevo transactional email. It allows to identify brevo_template_id Brevo template id target Audience of the Brevo transactional email: 'native' (beneficiaries) or 'pro' (cultural partners). email_id Recipient identifier: SHA-256 hash (hex) of the recipient email address. offerer_id Unique identifier of the offerer. user_id Unique identifier for a user. event_date The date when the event occurred, used for partitioning the data. total_delivered Count of emails successfully delivered to the recipient. total_opened Count of emails opened by the recipient. total_unsubscribed Count of recipients who unsubscribed after receiving the email.
